model: EE600D / EE610D differential pressure transmitter (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: E+E EE600 and EE610 differential pressure transmitters with the RS485 BACnet MS/TP output.
summary: The EE600D and EE610D are differential pressure transmitters that report over BACnet MS/TP as a smart sensor. The EE600D exposes pressure plus calculated air velocity, volume flow, filter contamination and level; the EE610D (+/-100 Pa) only exposes differential pressure.
notes: Object list from the PICS sections 11-12; the EE610D supports only AI 0 and the device object.
Units are selectable per object; the object description changes with the unit (for example "Differential pressure [Pa]").
All objects are read-only except Present_Value while Out_Of_Service is true.

integration.summary: Give the transmitter a unique device instance and MAC address, then poll AI 0 for differential pressure. On the EE600D the calculated velocity, flow, filter and level values are on AI 1-4 if the application uses them.
setup: Device instance (0-4194302) and device name are writable and kept in non-volatile memory; the default name is the model plus 8 unique characters.
RS485 settings are one writable string property, default "38400-8n1"; baud 9600-115200, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit fixed.
Max Master is writable, up to 127.
ReinitializeDevice and DeviceCommunicationControl need the password printed in the PICS.
gotchas: COV reporting stays off until COV_Increment is set; COV messages are broadcast (no subscription list).
Present_Value is only writable while Out_Of_Service is true; the value then defaults to 50.0.
Reliability reads NO_SENSOR when the sensing element is damaged or missing.

points.name: p
points.units: Pa / kPa / mbar / mm WC / in WC
